programs.desc: Ben's little brother and his wife secretly buy a fixer-upper and plan to renovate it themselves to save money; as they move and race to finish before their third baby arrives, Ben and Erin try to convince them to accept some help.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: Over 13 years, a couple has have moved countless times, living separately and out of suitcases through medical school and residency; now, with two kids and life more settled, they turn to Ben and Erin to find their first permanent family home.

programs.desc: Ben and Erin help their best friends turn a dilapidated 1930s department store into Laurel's first boutique hotel; with crushing financial risks and six months to open, they must finish a prototype room to secure bookings.

programs.title: Home Town: Inn This Together

programs.title: Farmhouse Fixer
programs.desc: Jon Knight and Kristina Crestin have their biggest budget yet to overhaul an old family home while honoring three generations of memories; they give this family a breezy, coastal home full of sentimental touches and nods to their farming history.

programs.title: Farmhouse Fixer
programs.desc: Jon Knight picks up a 110-year-old house and moves it, because it's been in the Knight family for 20 years, and Jon wants it to be a home for his whole family to visit for years to come; the farm ducks get a new floating duck house.
